summary: 4 MEDIUM + 4 NIT findings. Design product-facts are highly accurate (verified against E:\kiswap source and the npm registry), but 4 design-level issues need concrete fixes before implementation.

findings.title: Search-index path normalization unspecified for Windows
findings.problem: The design states the stored path field uses '/' as separator, but gen-search.mjs runs an fs walk on Windows (this environment) where path.relative results use '\'. The normalization step is never specified, so a raw Windows relpath like 'memulai\pengenalan' becomes '/docs/memulai\pengenalan' and router.push on it 404s, breaking FR-2.5 search-result navigation. content.ts is unaffected (its slug comes from URL params).
findings.fix: In gen-search.mjs: const rel = path.relative(CONTENT_DIR, file); const slug = rel.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\.mdx$/, ''); entry.path = '/docs/' + slug; assert no entry.path contains '\'.

findings.title: /docs redirect will not fire under dynamicParams=false
findings.problem: With an optional catch-all [[...slug]] and dynamicParams=false, only paths whose params match a generateStaticParams entry are served. The design emits only real pages (non-empty slug arrays), so the bare /docs (empty slug) is not among them and returns 404 under dynamicParams=false; the in-page redirect('/docs/memulai/pengenalan') never executes.
findings.fix: Either (a) include {slug:[]} in generateStaticParams and redirect in-page when !slug?.length, or (b) add a dedicated src/app/docs/page.tsx whose only line is redirect('/docs/memulai/pengenalan').

findings.title: Conflicting location for the mdxComponents map
findings.problem: §4 lists src/lib/typography.ts as 'ekspor mdxComponents map + plugin lists' AND lists src/components/mdx/mdxComponents.tsx as the 'map elemen → komponen' used by <MDXRemote components=...>. §5 then points the route to src/components/mdx/mdxComponents.tsx. Two files are both described as exporting the components map; the import source is ambiguous.
findings.fix: Make src/components/mdx/mdxComponents.tsx the sole owner of mdxComponents; src/lib/typography.ts exports only remarkPlugins/rehypePlugins arrays. Route imports mdxComponents from the former and plugins from the latter.

findings.title: SearchDialog open-state cannot be shared via 'prop callback' across layouts
findings.problem: TopNav is in the root layout and Sidebar is in the docs layout; they are neither siblings nor parent-child, so a plain prop callback cannot share SearchDialog isOpen state, and the design never says where <SearchDialog/> mounts. As described, at most one trigger could open the dialog, breaking FR-2.5/AC-11 search from the other.
findings.fix: Add a client SearchProvider context in src/app/layout.tsx owning isOpen and rendering <SearchDialog/> once; TopNav and Sidebar call useSearch().open(). Replace the 'prop callback' wording with this provider.

findings.title: Tailwind pinned to 3.4.19; requirement names 3.4.0
findings.problem: KORAMP uses tailwindcss 3.4.0 (verified in E:\kiswap\package.json); the requirement names 3.4.0 for consistency. The design pins 3.4.19 without acknowledging the deviation. AC-10 still satisfied; 3.4.19 is in the 3.4 line with no peer issue, so impact is low.
findings.fix: Pin tailwindcss to 3.4.0 to match KORAMP and the requirement, or add a one-line rationale for 3.4.19 next to §3.

findings.title: TOC/heading slug parity invariant overstated
findings.problem: The same github-slugger@2 version gives identical slugs only for identical input. content.ts slugs RAW markdown heading text (regex); rehype-slug slugs RENDERED text content (hast-util-to-string strips formatting and link targets). For headings containing links/images the slugs diverge, so a TOC anchor can point to a non-existent id. The design's unified-pipeline fallback is reactive, not preventive.
findings.fix: Add a §17 content rule 'H2/H3 headings must be plain text, no links/images' and state parity holds under it, or default to unified rehype-slug+collector extraction.

findings.title: Content-file count misstated (19 vs 18)
findings.problem: §4 file tree and §6 nav table define 18 pages (Memulai 3 + Integrasi 4 + Privasi 4 + Arsitektur 5 + API Reference 1 + Roadmap 1 = 18). §20 says '19 file'. No 19th page is referenced elsewhere.

findings.title: Search scoring 'token-match' underspecified
findings.problem: For multi-token queries it is unspecified whether ALL tokens must match (AND) or ANY (OR), in which fields, and how multi-match rank combines.
findings.fix: Specify AND across tokens over title∪headings∪description∪excerpt; rank by weighted match count (title×4, headings×2, description×1, excerpt×1); ties by nav order; return top 8.
